method: Use recorded full timeouts with one timeout at the clock; require the reconstructed immediate changes to equal all raw substitutions at that clock. Verify both positive and no-substitution labels against the retained feed and the independent sequence audit.
limitations: This conservative subset excludes ambiguous same-clock events and all other stoppage types; it is not an exhaustive or unbiased sample of legal opportunities. Rosters are retrospective actual participants, not pre-game availability. It does not establish a deployable substitution hazard or causal game-state effects.
